pages.text: The Carving Knife is a simple tool crafted from a Stick, an Iron Ingot and a Crystallized Bond. While it can be used as a Sword in combat - even supporting the same enchantments - it is ill-advised to do so. Instead, it is much more useful for carving off flesh from $(l:blocks/tissue_skin_hair)$(c)$(o)Tissue$() blocks, tearing scutes off of Turtles, harvesting the horns of a Goat, or butchering Rabbits for their feet.

Tissue blocks that have had Organic Matter applied will not decay after reducing the flesh on them. As for the scutes or horns, harvesting them in such a forceful way will hurt the animal. Additionally, it can be used to carve off one's own flesh if used while crouching...

Another use for the Carving Knife is to get the Skull of a Skeleton. First, the Skeleton has to be sufficiently hurt, and then it's a trial and error to try and carve the Skull off with the knife. Whenever the carving fails, it will greatly damage the knife. While this same method can be used for Wither Skeletons too, due to their more rigid bones, the chance of failure is considerably higher.
